Swifty Companion is only for the 42 community. To look up profiles, sign in with your 42 intra account. You type your password on the intra\'s own page: the app never sees it and only keeps your login on this device.
I have read and accept the terms of use and the privacy policy.

Swifty Companion lets members of the 42 community look up 42 student profiles through the 42 API. It is a personal, non-commercial project by ravazque, a student at 42 Madrid, and not an official 42 product.
Only people with a 42 intra account. You must sign in with your own account and must not share it.

Use the app only for purposes related to 42, such as finding fellow students or seeing how someone is progressing. Do not use it to collect, copy, publish or share other people\'s data, to harass anyone or for any commercial purpose. Follow 42\'s rules and respect the privacy of others.

All profile data comes from the 42 API and belongs to 42 and to the people it describes. The app may present it differently from the intra: for example, whether someone is on freeze or blackholed is deduced from the API and can be wrong.
The app is provided as is, without any guarantee, and may stop working if 42 changes its API or its rules for applications.
You can stop using the app at any time by signing out or uninstalling it.
If these terms change, the app will ask you to accept the new version before your next search.

Swifty Companion is a personal, non-commercial app made by ravazque, a student at 42 Madrid. It has no server of its own: it runs on your device and only talks to 42. For any question about this policy, contact ravazque through the 42 intra.

You sign in on the 42 intra\'s own page, so the app never sees your password. The intra then gives the app a temporary key for your account, which it uses once to read your login and then discards. On this device the app keeps only your login, the version of these texts you accepted and when, to remember your session.

The profiles shown (name, login, photo, location, wallet, correction points, level, skills, projects and coalition) come from the 42 API: the same data the intra shows. They stay in memory while the app is open, and photos and coalition logos are also kept in the app\'s image cache. The app does not send them anywhere.
What is stored on this device

In the app\'s private storage, which other apps cannot read and which is left out of backups: your session while you are signed in, the app\'s own key for the 42 API, your settings (language, search options, project filter and order) and the image cache.
What the app does not do
No analytics, no advertising, no tracking and no accounts of its own. The only services it contacts are the 42 API and 42\'s image servers.
The data is used only to let members of the 42 community look up 42 profiles, as they can on the intra. Signing in makes sure that only people with a 42 account use the app.

You can sign out at any time from your login at the top of the search screen; your session is then deleted from this device. Clearing the app\'s data or uninstalling it deletes everything it stored. Your 42 profile itself is managed by 42: to access, correct or delete that data, contact your campus.
If this policy changes, the app will ask you to accept the new version before your next search.
